newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP says looking for 3 new board members.
newsitem.headline: BHP says looking for 3 new board members.

text.p: Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) managing director John Prescott said on Tuesday the company was looking for three new board members to replace two recent resignations and one forthcoming retirement.
"We have had a couple of recent retirments and another one is scheduled in the next 12 months," Prescott told reporters.
Asked if any of the new appointements would be executive directors, he said: "The chairman has indicated the next two or three appointments will be non-executive."
He said the appointments would be long-term.
Three senior executives resigned from BHP management earlier this month -- minerals division chief Dick Carter, iron ore head Geoff Wedlock and petroleum division chief John O'Connor.
